controls: The backup will begin after you have printed or saved the instructions.

&Save instructions to a safe location
If you can't print, save the instructions to a location other than the failing disk, such as a USB flash drive, a CD, or a network location.

S&kip instructions
Printing or saving the instructions is strongly recommended. However, if you can’t print or save now, you can begin the backup process.
